page_title: WOL 0-1 WER | Wolfsburg v Werder Bremen 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mick Schmetgens (Werder Bremen) replaces Leonardo Bittencourt.
90+5' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is booked for saying more than Benjamin Brand was willing to tolerate.
90+4' PENALTY APPEAL by Wolfsburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+2' The match has ended for Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Benjamin Brand pulls out a red card!
90+2' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) crosses the ball into the box from a free kick, but his attempt is well judged by the keeper who saves comfortably.
90+2' That's a free kick to Wolfsburg.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
87' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a free kick, but the defence is well positioned and clears the ball away from danger.

86' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Salim Musah (Werder Bremen). Benjamin Brand saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolfsburg.
85' Substitution. Justin Njinmah walks off the pitch and Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
79' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Vini Souza is replaced by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
79' Substitution. Joakim Maehle makes way for Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
79' A corner kick by Werder Bremen is thwarted by the well prepared Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg).

78' What a great touch by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
77' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:3.
73' Dieter Hecking decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Amoura will be replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
73' It's time for a substitution. Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Jonas Wind.
72' The resulting corner, taken by Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg), comes to nothing.
68' What a screamer! The ball falls to Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) on the edge of the box after several rebounds and he doesn't hesitate to rifle it off the post into the bottom left corner.
66' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
64' Jesper Lindstrom comes off the pitch to be replaced by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).
61' Daniel Thioune is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) suffers an injury and Karim Coulibaly comes on.
61' Daniel Thioune has decided to substitute Samuel Mbangula and he is replaced by Felix Agu (Werder Bremen).

60' Golden chance! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
59' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:5.
56' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
55' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
54' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) takes a short corner kick.
49' Great touch by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
47' A cross from a corner kick by Werder Bremen is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Wolfsburg fail to score from a corner as Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen) leaps to collect the ball.
42' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
39' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
38' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mio Backhaus reads it well and gathers the ball.
38' A cross into the box from Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is cleared. Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.

35' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Werder Bremen.
32' The ball possession is 60:40.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
28' The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a throw-in.
25' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat.

22' A clever short pass gives Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
19' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

16' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is very close to scoring! He climbs high to meet a well-taken corner kick and sends it towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper shows good reflexes as he launches himself into the air and stops the header.
15' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolfsburg.

13' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the right side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara makes a nice save.
11' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul after Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) hacks down one of his opponents. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
10' The free kick from long range, taken by Werder Bremen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
3' Werder Bremen are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Wolfsburg will take the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
